'''Michael Rodriguez''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Massachusetts State Championship]] on 29 April 2000 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit with Aliens]], according to Michael Hawley's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d645">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-01-massachusetts-states-boxboro-4-29-00d645/ massachusetts-states-boxboro-4-29-00], DeckTech (Michael "rayc" Hawley, 1 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-01-massachusetts-states-boxboro-4-29-00d645/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
